concept.title: Firefox Release and ESR policy differences
concept.shortdesc: Use channel badges and the active schema channel to avoid configuring policies that are unavailable in the selected Firefox family.

section.title: Current channels
section.p: BPM supports Firefox Release 153, Firefox ESR 153.0, Firefox ESR 140.13, and Firefox ESR 115.39. ESR 115.39 provides limited critical-security support for organizations with legacy operating systems; it does not extend operating-system vendor support, and BPM rechecks the reviewed boundary on 2027-03-01. The ESR artifacts are independent supported channels; BPM does not migrate a profile automatically while its ESR line remains supported.

section.title: Support badges
section.p: Each policy reference lists its exact supported channels. A badge that includes Release 153 and ESR 153.0 does not imply support in ESR 140.13 or ESR 115.39. Use the exact generated artifact and badge rather than treating ESR names as aliases.

section.title: Policies unavailable in ESR 140.13
section.p: Nine policies are available in both Release 153 and ESR 153.0 but not ESR 140.13: AIControls, BrowserDataBackup, DisableRemoteImprovements, DisableRemoteSettingsAndAcceptSecurityConsequences, GenerativeAI, IPProtectionAvailable, LocalNetworkAccess, VisualSearchEnabled, and XSLTEnabled. SitePolicies is available only in Release 153; DefaultBrowserSettingEnabled is available only in ESR 153.0.

section.title: Changed definitions
section.p: Cookies, ExtensionSettings, and Homepage have channel-specific definitions. In particular, the Firefox 153 channels add extension permission and host controls; validate the selected channel before export.

section.title: User action
section.p: Select the Firefox schema during create or duplicate preparation, verify its exact badge, and revalidate before export. The editor header is read-only. A user may choose any distinct currently supported artifact as an explicit conversion target, but preview can report unchanged or transformed items or block the operation. Only an applicable, target-valid current preview with no blockers can be confirmed and applied; no unavailable policy is silently removed.

section.title: Current 0.9.6 behavior
section.p: Schema, preset, and CIS baseline are selected during preparation and remain read-only in the editor. For another saved profile, use explicit conversion or duplicate preparation; an unsupported or blocked case never silently drops values. Guided owners are Step 2 for URLs/sites, Step 4 for certificates and trust, and Step 6 for extensions.
